subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when a model repeatedly streams identical or cyclic assistant text: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback/quarantine, or a combination?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, whether approve should resume a suspect generation, and how to sanitize session history are product and compatibility choices automation should not invent.

options.title: Approve core stream guard design
options.body: Define default thresholds, alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementing the guard in the embedded-agent stream path.

options.title: Defer to timeout work
options.body: Keep this open but wait for generation-timeout and provider-watchdog decisions before adding semantic stream detection.

options.title: Reject pause-and-resume semantics
options.body: Allow only abort-and-quarantine behavior so a detector cannot continue a poisoned generation after user approval.

recommendation.title: Approve core stream guard design
recommendation.body: Define default thresholds, alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementing the guard in the embedded-agent stream path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from adjacent guardrail/config history and prior product-decision ownership signals in the issue timeline.
